messages.text: Hello
Hi Jeff, good to hear from you. What can I help you with today?

Sarah i hope you can help me.  I return a defective device and they gave me store credit.  I was really hoping for my money back. Im in a financial pinch and I could really use that money.  Is there anyways you can help me
Used the store-orders skill
Handed to the team · Converting issued store credit into a card refund is not something I can do.

I hear you, Jeff, and I'm sorry you're in that spot.

Your NerdQX came back to us on October 13, the board fault was confirmed, and it was settled yesterday as $299.49 in store credit on your account. Turning that credit into money back on your card isn't something I can do myself, so I've put it in front of a supervisor to review.

They're on now, so stay in the chat and one of them will pick it up here. If you step away, the answer comes to your email.
Thank you
Of course, Jeff. Hang tight here and someone from the team will come back to you on it. If there's anything else on your orders in the meantime, just say.
Any updates
Used the store-orders skill

Nothing new on it yet, Jeff. The credit question is sitting with a supervisor and they'll come back to you here, or by email if you step away.

While you wait: your two Bitaxe Gamma 602 orders (Shop···· and Shop····) are both still waiting on stock at the warehouse, and I don't have a date I'd trust on them yet. That one is already with the team too.
Ill like to cancel those as well

Understood, Jeff. Those two are past their dates and that's on us.

Two things I can do myself right now: swap either one to something we have in stock, or cancel and put the full amount on your account as store credit for whenever you want it.

Money back on the card isn't mine to do, so that would go to a supervisor along with the credit question already with them. Which would you like me to put forward?
Any updates yet
Used the store-orders skill

Still nothing back from the supervisor on the $299.49, Jeff. It's in front of them and they'll answer here or by email.

On the two Bitaxe orders, tell me which way you want to go and I'll move on it now: swap to something in stock, or cancel them into store credit. If it's money you want on those, say so and I'll put that in front of the supervisor with the rest.
Money back please
Used the store-orders skill
Handed to the team · Cancellation with money back is a supervisor decision, not mine.

Done, Jeff. Both Bitaxe orders, Shop···· at $92.00 and Shop···· at $72.00, are now in front of the supervisor with the money-back request, alongside the $299.49.

Nothing has shipped on either, so nothing changes on your side meanwhile. Stay in the chat and they'll come back here, or by email to this address if you step away.
Thank you
You're welcome, Jeff. It's with them now, and a copy of this whole conversation goes to your email once we're done here, so you'll have it in writing.
I appreciate that
Glad to help, Jeff. I'll keep an eye on it from this side too. If anything else comes up on your units while you wait, just write here.
Has the supervisor looked at this yet
Used the store-orders skill

No decision on it yet, Jeff. Both Bitaxe orders are sitting on hold, nothing cancelled and nothing refunded so far, and the $299.49 is still open too.

It's with them and I'll say so here the moment anything moves. If you'd rather not sit in the chat, the answer reaches this email either way.
What time do you use
Eastern time, Jeff. The team works 10am to 6pm ET, Monday to Friday, so right now it's Friday 4:33pm and they're still on for another hour and a half.
